blind.description: A stylized medieval or fantasy scriptorium desk with an attached bench seat. It features a slanted reading/writing surface holding an open manuscript book with painted pages, a flat top shelf with a green ceramic inkpot and a white quill feather, and paneled wooden sides and back. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and stylized with hand-painted textures; no broken geometry or floating parts.
blind.from_above: A compact rectangular layout showing the wooden bench along the left, the open book pages in the center-left, and the top narrow ledge on the right holding a round green ink pot and a pointed white quill.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly 60% of the figure's height) and about 3 feet wide.
